newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks sag at noon on uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks sag at noon on uncertainty.

text.p: Pakistani stocks sagged at noon on Tuesday as blue chips tumbled due to political and economic uncertainty and dealers said they expected the index to dip further as there was no positive news.

"Major players are on the sidelines as they await the outcome of Pakistan-IMF talks for the resumption of the standby loan," a dealer said. "The overall market mood is negative as there is no good news on the political or economic fronts."
The Karachi 100-share index fell 10.62 points, or 0.77 percent, to 1,376.33 at noon. Losers beat gainers 116 to 44. PTCL fell 0.75 rupees to 31.50. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
